title: ios-acceptance-guards
responsibility: Owns the ios-acceptance-guards build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: localOrigin.origin
inputs.description: The origin to test, as a string such as http://127.0.0.1:8787, before the run may talk to it. Only plain http on 127.0.0.1 with a port of 2 to 5 digits and nothing after the port passes, so localhost, https and a trailing slash are refused.

inputs.name: redacted.text
inputs.description: The text to scrub of secrets before the run prints or writes it. Each listed secret, and its form with every character outside A-Z, a-z and 0-9 removed, is replaced by [hidden] wherever it occurs, matching exactly and case-sensitively.

inputs.name: redacted.secrets
inputs.description: The secrets to hide, each matched as written and with every character outside A-Z, a-z and 0-9 removed; a form shorter than 4 characters is ignored. An empty list hides nothing.

inputs.name: expiredOffer.scan
inputs.description: The offer string whose first ;exp=<digits>; segment is replaced by an expiry 60 seconds before the time given as expiredOffer.now. A string with no such segment is returned unchanged.

inputs.name: expiredOffer.now
inputs.description: The time to age the offer against, in epoch milliseconds as Date.now() gives it; the new exp is 60 seconds before it. Defaults to Date.now(), evaluated at each call.

inputs.name: otherVersion.scan
inputs.description: The offer string whose first harness-pair:v1; is changed to harness-pair:v2;. A string without harness-pair:v1; is returned unchanged.

outputs.name: loopbackArgument
outputs.description: The launch argument by which a Debug product, and only a Debug product, accepts a local relay: the fixed string -HarnessRemoteLoopback.

outputs.name: localOrigin
outputs.description: True only for plain http on 127.0.0.1 with a port of 2 to 5 digits and nothing after the port, the only address the run talks to; false for every other origin.

outputs.name: redacted
outputs.description: The input text with each form of a listed secret (as written, or with every character outside A-Z, a-z and 0-9 removed) that has at least 4 characters replaced by [hidden]; text with none of these forms, or an empty secrets list, comes back unchanged.

outputs.name: scanMarker
outputs.description: The words by which a product is known to hold the TEST ONLY scan fixture; no product of the real source does. It is the fixed string HarnessSyntheticScans.

outputs.name: scanArgument
outputs.description: The launch argument that tells the TEST ONLY scan fixture copy what its scans answer: the fixed string -HarnessSyntheticScans, which is scanMarker with a leading dash.

outputs.name: expiredOffer
outputs.description: The offer with its first ;exp=<digits>; replaced by an expiry 60 seconds before the time given as expiredOffer.now, so a phone must refuse it as expired; an offer with no such segment comes back unchanged.

outputs.name: otherVersion
outputs.description: The offer with its first harness-pair:v1; changed to harness-pair:v2;, a version no phone knows, so a phone must refuse it as unsupported; an offer without harness-pair:v1; comes back unchanged.
